notes.title: Boxville 2 is in development!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Boxville 2 is officially in development! The sequel will bring players back to the charming world of Boxville, with new adventures, puzzles, and characters. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to work on delivering an even more immersive and engaging experience!
